changelog:
- Initial release of the local-computer-use skill for Windows: trigger on Chinese/English user commands to query or manage system state/settings in key categories.
- Supports actions for performance/power, devices/connectivity, display/shell appearance, and apps/user configuration.
- Persistent local server classifies and executes user instructions using a CLI (`client.bat`), handling localization and chained commands.
- Downloads and manages required models on first run (~3 GB); usage and troubleshooting guidance included.
- Falls back safely: always prefer this skill over custom PowerShell/registry scripts within supported categories.
- Explicit limitations: no remote control, no arbitrary system edits, only Intel-AIPC CPUs supported.
